name: ORDER_RES_3
description: The ORDER_RES_3 table contains result finding information for an order. Result findings include mammography pathology results, cardiovascular palette findings, and other result findings.

columns.name: FINDING_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the finding record.

columns.name: LUNG_SEC_HIST_C_NAME
columns.description: Determines the type of cancer that was found in the secondary cell type of the tissue sample.

columns.name: LUNG_SEC_NONSMALL_C_NAME
columns.description: If secondary histology is "Non Small Cell Lung Cancer", then this item specifies the type of the cancer.

columns.name: LUNG_SEC_NS_COMM
columns.description: If Secondary histology - Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer is Other, Specify, then this item holds a free text description of the cancer.

columns.name: FIRST_DOCUMENTED_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time when this lesion was first documented.

columns.name: FOLLOWUP_CUR_RESP_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: FINDING_HIDDEN_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether a finding in the image documentation section in study review for a breast imaging study is hidden. 'Y' indicates that a finding has been hidden. 'N' or NULL indicate that a finding has not been hidden.

columns.name: FINDING_SUP_MOPS_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether a finding in the image documentation section in study review for a MOPS breast imaging study is suppressed. 'Y' indicates that a finding has been suppressed. 'N' or NULL indicate that a finding has not been suppressed.

columns.name: LUNG_HISTOLOGY_OTHER
columns.description: If RES 52271 - LUNG HISTOLOGY contains Other, this item contains a free text description of the cancer.

columns.name: LUNG_SECONDARY_HISTOLOGY_OTHER
columns.description: If RES 52283 - LUNG SECONDARY HISTOLOGY contains Other, this item contains a free text description of the secondary cancer.

columns.name: ANAT_LOC_CODE_SYS
columns.description: The terminology system used to specifiy the anatomic location of the observation.

columns.name: ANAT_LOC_CODE
columns.description: The anatomic location of the observation. This code is part of the anatomic location code system (stored in I RES 52560).

columns.name: ANAT_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The display name of the observation's anatomic location code (I RES 52561).

columns.name: OBS_CODE_SYS
columns.description: The terminology system that the observation code (I RES 52566) belongs to.

columns.name: OBS_CODE
columns.description: The element set (observation) that this record represents. This code is part of the observation code system (stored in I RES 52565).

columns.name: OBS_NAME
columns.description: The display name of the observation code (I RES 52566).

columns.name: FINDING_MNLY_EXCLD_YN
columns.description: This item indicates whether a finding was excluded from the result. 'Y' indicates that a finding is excluded from the result. 'N' or NULL indicate that a finding has not been excluded.
